modules.name: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards
Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: What is the mandatory action required when approaching this octagonal red traffic sign?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='30,5 70,5 95,30 95,70 70,95 30,95 5,70 5,30' fill='%23DC2626' stroke='white' stroke-width='4'/><text x='50' y='60' fill='white' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle'>STOP</text></svg>
questions.a: Slow down to 20 km/h and proceed if clear
questions.b: Come to a complete stop before the stop line or pedestrian lane and yield to all traffic
questions.c: Stop only if another motor vehicle is approaching from the right
questions.d: Honk your horn and proceed cautiously across the intersection
questions.explanation: Under DPWH & LTO regulations, an octagonal STOP sign requires a complete full stop at the stop line or pedestrian crossing, yielding the right of way to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this inverted triangular sign with a red border signify to approaching drivers?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='5,10 95,10 50,90' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><text x='50' y='42' fill='%23DC2626' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle'>GIVE</text><text x='50' y='60' fill='%23DC2626' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle'>WAY</text></svg>
questions.a: Vehicles on the main road must yield to you
questions.b: You have priority over all intersecting roads
questions.c: Slow down and give way (yield) to vehicles on the major road or roundabout
questions.d: Mandatory full stop for at least 5 seconds
questions.explanation: The GIVE WAY (YIELD) sign instructs drivers to slow down and prepare to stop if necessary to yield the right-of-way to vehicles on the priority road.

questions.question: What does a circular white sign with a red outer border and a red diagonal slash over a black left arrow indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><path d='M65 65 L65 48 Q65 38 52 38 L40 38 L40 28 L22 43 L40 58 L40 48 L52 48 Q55 48 55 52 L55 65 Z' fill='%23111827'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: Compulsory left turn ahead
questions.b: No Left Turn permitted at this intersection
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal slash is a prohibitory sign. Over a left arrow, it prohibits making any left turns.

questions.question: What is prohibited when encountering this red circle sign with a curved U-arrow and diagonal slash?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><path d='M65 65 L65 42 Q65 26 50 26 Q35 26 35 42 L35 52 L25 52 L38 68 L51 52 L41 52 L41 42 Q41 33 50 33 Q59 33 59 42 L59 65 Z' fill='%23111827'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: No Left Turn
questions.explanation: The No U-Turn regulatory sign strictly prohibits drivers from reversing direction 180 degrees at the marked location.

questions.question: What does a solid red circular sign displaying a bold horizontal white bar indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='%23DC2626'/><rect x='15' y='40' width='70' height='20' rx='3' fill='white'/></svg>
questions.a: No Parking
questions.c: NO ENTRY to all vehicular traffic
questions.explanation: The solid red disc with a horizontal white bar is the universal NO ENTRY sign prohibiting all vehicles from entering a one-way street or restricted zone.

questions.question: What does this circular sign showing a pedestrian symbol with a red diagonal slash mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><circle cx='50' cy='30' r='6' fill='%23111827'/><path d='M47 38 L53 38 L56 52 L50 56 L50 72 L45 72 L45 56 L41 46 Z' fill='%23111827'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: Pedestrians have right of way
questions.explanation: A pedestrian silhouette with a red diagonal slash indicates that pedestrians are prohibited from walking along or crossing this roadway (e.g. expressways).

questions.question: What does a circular blue sign containing a straight white arrow pointing directly upward signify?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='%232563EB'/><path d='M50 18 L68 38 L55 38 L55 78 L45 78 L45 38 L32 38 Z' fill='white'/></svg>
questions.a: One way street to the right
questions.explanation: Blue circular signs are mandatory regulatory signs. A vertical upward arrow indicates all vehicles must proceed straight ahead only; turning is not permitted.

questions.question: What does this circular blue sign with a white diagonal arrow pointing down and to the right instruct drivers to do?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='%232563EB'/><path d='M35 30 L55 50 L55 38 L68 38 L68 72 L34 72 L34 59 L46 59 Z' fill='white'/></svg>
questions.a: Keep Right of the traffic island or obstruction
questions.b: Right turn only at the next corner
questions.explanation: A blue circle with a downward-angled arrow is the mandatory KEEP RIGHT sign, directing traffic to pass to the right of a median island or divider.

questions.question: What does a circular sign depicting two cars side-by-side with a red diagonal slash prohibit?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><rect x='22' y='42' width='22' height='16' rx='3' fill='%23DC2626'/><rect x='54' y='42' width='22' height='16' rx='3' fill='%23111827'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: Drag racing on public roads
questions.explanation: The No Overtaking sign prohibits passing other vehicles on that section of the road due to limited sight distance, curves, or hazard areas.

questions.question: What is the meaning of a blue circular sign containing three curved white arrows in a clockwise circle?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='%232563EB'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='35 15'/><polygon points='75,45 85,55 75,65' fill='white'/></svg>
questions.a: U-turn slot ahead
questions.explanation: This mandatory sign directs drivers to navigate the upcoming roundabout (rotonda) in the specified circular direction.

questions.question: What does a circular white sign with a red border containing the numeral '60' mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><text x='50' y='62' fill='%23111827' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='32' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle'>60</text></svg>
questions.a: Minimum required speed is 60 km/h
questions.b: Maximum legal speed limit is 60 km/h
questions.explanation: A number inside a red circle is the Maximum Speed Limit sign. You must not exceed 60 km/h under normal road conditions.

questions.question: What does a blue circular sign with a red border and a single diagonal red slash over the letter 'P' indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='%232563EB' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><text x='50' y='65' fill='white' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='42' font-weight='900' text-anchor='middle'>P</text><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: No Parking anytime
questions.explanation: The letter 'P' with a red slash indicates NO PARKING. Stopping temporarily to load/unload passengers for less than 1 minute without leaving the driver's seat may be allowed unless a No Stopping sign is posted.

questions.question: What does a blue circular sign with a red border and a red 'X' (two intersecting diagonal slashes) signify?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='44' fill='%232563EB' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/><line x1='80' y1='20' x2='20' y2='80' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='8'/></svg>
questions.a: No Overtaking
questions.b: No Stopping and No Standing at any time
questions.explanation: A red 'X' over a blue circular disc is the NO STOPPING / NO STANDING sign, prohibiting even brief stops to drop off or pick up passengers.

questions.question: According to RA 4136, what is the maximum allowable speed limit for passenger cars and motorcycles on open country roads with no blind corners?
questions.a: 40 km/h
questions.explanation: Under Article I, Section 35 of RA 4136, the speed limit for passenger cars and motorcycles on open country roads with no blind corners is 80 km/h.

questions.question: According to RA 4136, within how many meters of an intersection is parking strictly prohibited?
questions.a: 2 meters
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 46, no driver shall park a vehicle within six (6) meters of the intersection of curb lines.

questions.question: What does this equilateral triangular warning sign with an arrow curving to the left warn the driver about?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M62 72 Q62 46 45 42 L45 32 L26 48 L45 64 L45 54 Q52 56 52 72 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Compulsory left turn ahead
questions.explanation: Triangular signs with red borders are Warning Signs. An arrow bending left warns of a sharp left curve ahead requiring speed reduction.

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting a reverse double curve (zigzag arrow turning left then right) signify?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M58 72 L58 60 Q58 52 48 52 Q38 52 38 42 L38 34 L26 44 L38 54 L38 48 Q44 48 48 58 L48 72 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Reverse Curve ahead (first to the left, then to the right)
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers of a reverse curve ahead where the road bends first to the left and then closely to the right.

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign showing an arrow that loops back 180 degrees (Hairpin Bend) indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M62 74 L62 48 Q62 28 50 28 Q38 28 38 48 L38 56 L26 56 L44 76 L62 56 L50 56 L50 48 Q50 38 50 38 Q52 38 52 48 L52 74 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: U-turn slot ahead
questions.explanation: The Hairpin Curve sign warns of an exceptionally sharp turn (common on mountain roads) requiring substantial braking and gear downshifting.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign showing a serpentine winding road symbol advise drivers to do?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M46 74 L46 64 Q46 56 54 56 Q62 56 62 46 Q62 38 50 34 L50 26 L38 38 L50 48 L50 42 Q54 44 54 48 Q54 50 48 50 Q38 50 38 62 L38 74 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Expect a series of continuous winding curves ahead
questions.b: Watch out for crossing reptiles and wildlife
questions.explanation: The Winding Road sign warns of a series of three or more consecutive curves ahead, advising drivers not to overtake and to reduce driving speed.

questions.question: When driving around sharp curves on two-lane mountain roads in the Philippines, which practice is essential?
questions.a: Overtake slow trucks before entering the curve
questions.b: Stay strictly in your lane, sound your horn near blind curves, and do not cross the center line
questions.c: Shift to neutral gear to conserve fuel
questions.d: Turn on hazard warning flashers while driving at high speed
questions.explanation: On blind mountain curves, crossing the center line or overtaking is extremely hazardous. Stay in your lane and sound your horn during daytime to alert oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign displaying a bold black plus symbol (+) warn of?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><rect x='45' y='32' width='10' height='44' fill='%23111827'/><rect x='28' y='49' width='44' height='10' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Hospital or first aid station ahead
questions.explanation: A black cross inside a triangular warning sign warns drivers of a 4-way crossroad intersection ahead, requiring vigilance for crossing vehicles.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign showing a bold black 'T' symbol indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><rect x='45' y='42' width='10' height='36' fill='%23111827'/><rect x='26' y='34' width='48' height='10' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: T-Junction ahead where the road terminates and you must turn left or right
questions.explanation: A T-junction sign indicates that the road you are traveling on ends ahead at a perpendicular intersecting highway where you must turn left or right.

questions.question: What does a triangular sign showing a black 'Y' symbol warn about?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M45 74 L45 54 L30 36 L39 30 L50 44 L61 30 L70 36 L55 54 L55 74 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Y-Junction ahead where the road forks into two branches
questions.explanation: The Y-junction sign warns that the single roadway divides ahead into two separate branches forming a Y-shape fork.

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign displaying a thick vertical line with a thinner line joining at a 45-degree angle from the right warn of?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><rect x='42' y='30' width='10' height='48' fill='%23111827'/><path d='M68 62 L50 46 L50 56 L62 68 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Merging traffic entering from the right ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers on a major road that side traffic is merging from the right ramp/side street ahead at an angle.

questions.question: When entering a multi-lane roundabout (rotonda) in the Philippines, which vehicle has the primary right-of-way?
questions.a: The vehicle entering the roundabout at highest speed
questions.b: Vehicles already navigating inside the circulatory roadway
questions.c: Public utility jeepneys and buses regardless of position
questions.d: The vehicle approaching from the leftmost entry lane
questions.explanation: Under standard Philippine traffic law and international conventions, vehicles already inside the roundabout circulatory roadway have right-of-way over vehicles entering.

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting road lines narrowing inward from both sides warn about?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M32 74 L32 58 L42 42 L42 30 L36 30 L36 40 L26 56 L26 74 Z' fill='%23111827'/><path d='M68 74 L68 58 L58 42 L58 30 L64 30 L64 40 L74 56 L74 74 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Road Narrows ahead on both sides
questions.explanation: The Road Narrows sign warns that the width of the carriageway is reducing from both sides, requiring drivers to merge smoothly and reduce speed.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting a car silhouette driving down a steep slope with a percentage (e.g. '10%') indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><polygon points='26,72 74,72 74,44' fill='%23111827'/><rect x='34' y='46' width='16' height='10' rx='2' transform='rotate(-22 34 46)' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Steep Hill Descent (downhill slope) ahead
questions.explanation: The Steep Descent sign warns of a dangerous downward slope ahead. Drivers should shift to a lower gear to use engine braking and avoid brake fade.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting two curved humps in the road surface warn drivers of?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M26 66 L34 66 Q40 50 46 66 Q52 50 58 66 L74 66 L74 72 L26 72 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Uneven or Bumpy Road surface ahead
questions.explanation: The Uneven Road sign warns of bumps, dips, or irregular road surface ahead that could compromise vehicle stability at higher speeds.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting rocks falling down a slope warn motorists about?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><polygon points='26,74 26,38 48,74' fill='%23111827'/><circle cx='58' cy='52' r='4' fill='%23111827'/><circle cx='66' cy='62' r='5' fill='%23111827'/><circle cx='54' cy='66' r='3' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Falling or Fallen Rocks hazard ahead
questions.explanation: The Falling Rocks sign warns that landslides or rockfalls may occur on that mountain section, and debris may be obstructing the lane.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards

questions.question: What dangerous phenomenon occurs when tires ride on a thin film of water rather than contacting the road surface during heavy rain?
questions.a: Engine vapor lock
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning occurs when water builds up under tires faster than tire treads can channel it away, causing total loss of steering and braking control.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Road Width, Hills & Physical Hazards

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign showing a person walking between zebra crossing stripes indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><rect x='28' y='72' width='44' height='4' fill='%23111827'/><rect x='32' y='64' width='36' height='4' fill='%23111827'/><circle cx='50' cy='32' r='5' fill='%23111827'/><path d='M47 38 L54 38 L57 48 L49 52 L52 64 L46 64 L44 52 L40 44 Z' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Pedestrian Crossing (Zebra Crosswalk) ahead; yield to crossing pedestrians
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a marked pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drivers must slow down and yield right-of-way to any pedestrian stepping onto the zebra stripes.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: What does a fluorescent yellow-green pentagonal (5-sided) or triangular sign showing two school children walking warn of?
questions.a: School Zone or Children Crossing ahead; reduce speed to 20 km/h
questions.explanation: The School Zone sign warns of school grounds or children crossing nearby. Drivers must observe school zone speed limits (maximum 20 km/h under RA 4136).
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: What does an 'X' shaped white crossbuck sign with the words 'RAILROAD CROSSING' require drivers to do?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><line x1='15' y1='15' x2='85' y2='85' stroke='white' stroke-width='16'/><line x1='15' y1='15' x2='85' y2='85' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='10'/><line x1='85' y1='15' x2='15' y2='85' stroke='white' stroke-width='16'/><line x1='85' y1='15' x2='15' y2='85' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='10'/></svg>
questions.a: Speed up to cross the tracks before the train arrives
questions.b: Slow down, look both ways, listen for train horns, and stop if a train is approaching
questions.c: Stop only if a barrier gate is closed
questions.explanation: A Railroad Crossing Crossbuck sign marks a railway track crossing. Drivers must look and listen in both directions and come to a complete stop if signals flash or a train approaches.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: What does a triangular warning sign depicting an animal silhouette (e.g. cow or deer) indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,8 92,88 8,88' fill='white' stroke='%23DC2626' stroke-width='7'/><path d='M32 50 Q36 42 46 44 L64 44 Q70 44 72 50 L72 66 L66 66 L66 56 L54 56 L54 66 L48 66 L48 54 L36 54 L36 66 L30 66 Z' fill='%23111827'/><circle cx='28' cy='46' r='4' fill='%23111827'/></svg>
questions.a: Livestock / Animal Crossing zone ahead
questions.explanation: The Animal Crossing sign warns of areas where farm animals or wildlife may wander onto the roadway, particularly in rural provincial highways.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: When approaching a stopped school bus displaying flashing red lights and an extended stop arm in the Philippines, you must:
questions.a: Overtake quickly on the left shoulder
questions.b: Come to a complete stop until the lights stop flashing and children have safely crossed
questions.c: Sound your horn repeatedly and drive past at 30 km/h
questions.d: Slow down only if driving a heavy truck
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights on a school bus mean children are boarding or disembarking. Traffic in both directions on undivided roads must stop completely.
questions.moduleName: Warning Signs: Pedestrians, Schools & Special Hazards

questions.question: What does a Single Solid White center line on a two-lane road indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='white' stroke-width='6'/></svg>
questions.a: Overtaking is permitted anytime
questions.b: Separates traffic moving in opposite directions; crossing or overtaking is discouraged/prohibited
questions.explanation: A solid white line indicates that lane changing or crossing into opposing traffic is hazardous and discouraged, commonly used near junctions or blind spots.

questions.question: What does a Single Broken White center line on a multi-lane or two-way road mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='30' stroke='white' stroke-width='6'/><line x1='50' y1='42' x2='50' y2='60' stroke='white' stroke-width='6'/><line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='white' stroke-width='6'/></svg>
questions.a: Lane changing and overtaking are permitted when safe to do so
questions.explanation: A broken white line separates lanes moving in the same direction or opposite directions where overtaking/lane switching is permitted when safe.

questions.question: What does a Double Solid Yellow line painted along the center of the road strictly mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><line x1='44' y1='10' x2='44' y2='90' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='56' y1='10' x2='56' y2='90' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/></svg>
questions.a: Overtaking is strictly prohibited for vehicles traveling in both directions
questions.b: Overtaking is permitted only during daytime
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean absolute prohibition of passing or crossing from either side under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does a combination of a Solid Yellow line with an adjacent Broken Yellow line mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><line x1='44' y1='10' x2='44' y2='90' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='56' y1='10' x2='56' y2='30' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='56' y1='42' x2='56' y2='60' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='56' y1='72' x2='56' y2='90' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/></svg>
questions.a: Only traffic on the side of the broken line may overtake when safe
questions.explanation: Vehicles traveling adjacent to the broken line may cross to overtake when clear, while traffic on the solid line side is strictly prohibited from passing.

questions.question: What does a Yellow Box painted with crisscross diagonal lines at an intersection mean?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><rect x='20' y='20' width='60' height='60' fill='none' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='5'/><line x1='20' y1='20' x2='80' y2='80' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='4'/><line x1='80' y1='20' x2='20' y2='80' stroke='%23FBBF24' stroke-width='4'/></svg>
questions.a: Do not enter the box unless your exit road is clear (No blocking the intersection)
questions.explanation: A Yellow Box Junction must never be blocked. Drivers must not enter the box unless their exit on the other side is completely clear to prevent gridlock.

questions.question: What does a Steady Red traffic light signal require drivers to do?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='25' y='5' width='50' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937' stroke='white' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='50' cy='25' r='12' fill='%23DC2626'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='%23374151'/><circle cx='50' cy='75' r='12' fill='%23374151'/></svg>
questions.a: Come to a complete stop before the stop line and remain stopped until green appears
questions.b: Proceed cautiously if no police officer is present
questions.d: Slow down to 10 km/h and cross if intersection is empty
questions.explanation: A steady red light mandates a complete stop before the stop line or pedestrian lane until a green signal or authorized green turn arrow appears.

questions.question: What is the meaning of a Flashing Yellow traffic light at an intersection?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='25' y='5' width='50' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937' stroke='white' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='50' cy='25' r='12' fill='%23374151'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='%23FBBF24'/><circle cx='50' cy='75' r='12' fill='%23374151'/></svg>
questions.a: Prepare to stop completely immediately
questions.b: Slow down and proceed with caution through the intersection, yielding to cross traffic if necessary
questions.c: Traffic light is defective; speed up to clear intersection
questions.d: Pedestrians are not allowed to cross
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light serves as a warning signal. Motorists should reduce speed and proceed through the junction with heightened caution.

questions.question: What does a Flashing Red traffic light signal indicate?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='25' y='5' width='50' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937' stroke='white' stroke-width='2'/><circle cx='50' cy='25' r='12' fill='%23DC2626'/><circle cx='50' cy='50' r='12' fill='%23374151'/><circle cx='50' cy='75' r='12' fill='%23374151'/></svg>
questions.a: Equivalent to a STOP sign: come to a full complete stop, yield to cross traffic, then proceed when clear
questions.explanation: A flashing red light operates identically to an octagonal STOP sign: you must make a complete stop before the crosswalk, yielding to all cross traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: When a traffic enforcer is manually directing traffic and their signal conflicts with a green traffic light, which instruction must you follow?
questions.a: Always follow the traffic enforcer's manual hand signals over the electric traffic light
questions.b: Follow the electric traffic light at all times
questions.c: Honk your horn and wait until both signals match
questions.d: Follow the action of the car directly ahead of you
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 and LTO regulations, manual instructions from an authorized traffic enforcer or police officer supersede and override all automated traffic lights and road signs.

questions.question: What is the proper hand signal for making a Left Turn when your electric turn signals are inoperative?
questions.a: Extend left arm and hand horizontally straight out of the window
questions.b: Extend left arm pointing upward at a 90-degree angle
questions.c: Extend left arm pointing downward at a 90-degree angle
questions.d: Wave left hand rapidly in a circular motion
questions.explanation: To signal a left turn manually, extend the left arm horizontally straight out from the driver's side window.

questions.question: At an uncontrolled 4-way intersection where two vehicles arrive at the exact same time from perpendicular roads, who has the right-of-way?
questions.imageUrl: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><rect x='5' y='5' width='90' height='90' rx='10' fill='%231F2937'/><rect x='36' y='0' width='28' height='100' fill='%23374151'/><rect x='0' y='36' width='100' height='28' fill='%23374151'/><rect x='44' y='68' width='12' height='20' rx='3' fill='%233B82F6'/><rect x='68' y='44' width='20' height='12' rx='3' fill='%2310B981'/><text x='50' y='78' fill='white' font-size='8' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle'>A</text><text x='78' y='52' fill='white' font-size='8' font-weight='bold' text-anchor='middle'>B</text></svg>
questions.a: Vehicle A (on the vertical road)
questions.b: Vehicle B on the right side of Vehicle A has the right-of-way
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 42(a), when two vehicles approach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the vehicle on their right.

questions.question: When making a Left Turn across opposing oncoming traffic at an intersection without a green turn arrow, you must:
questions.a: Speed up to turn before oncoming vehicles arrive
questions.b: Yield the right-of-way to all oncoming vehicles proceeding straight or turning right
questions.d: Flash your high beams to force oncoming traffic to stop
questions.explanation: Under Section 42(b) of RA 4136, a driver intending to turn left within an intersection must yield the right of way to any oncoming vehicle approaching straight or turning right.

questions.question: When an authorized Emergency Vehicle (Ambulance, Fire Truck, or Police Car) approaches sounding a siren or flashing red/blue lights, what must all drivers do?
questions.a: Speed up to clear the road ahead of the ambulance
questions.b: Immediately drive to the right-hand edge/curb of the road and come to a complete stop until it passes
questions.c: Stop immediately in the center lane
questions.d: Follow closely behind the emergency vehicle to bypass heavy traffic
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 43, drivers must immediately pull over as close as possible to the right-hand curb and remain stopped until the emergency vehicle has completely passed.

questions.question: When entering a public highway or thoroughfare from a private driveway, garage, or building alley, who has the right-of-way?
questions.a: The vehicle exiting the private driveway
questions.b: All vehicles already traveling on the public highway
questions.c: The vehicle moving at the higher speed
questions.explanation: Under Section 42(c) of RA 4136, a driver entering a public highway from a private road or driveway must yield the right of way to all vehicles approaching on the highway.

questions.question: On a steep, narrow mountain road where two vehicles cannot pass each other simultaneously, which vehicle has the right-of-way?
questions.a: The vehicle descending (going downhill)
questions.explanation: The vehicle traveling uphill (ascending) has the right of way because it is harder to regain momentum and start from a standstill on a steep grade. The downhill vehicle must back up if needed.

questions.question: As a general rule on Philippine roads, on which side must a driver overtake or pass another vehicle traveling in the same direction?
questions.a: On the left side only, after signaling and ensuring the lane is clear
questions.b: On the right shoulder whenever traffic is slow
questions.c: On whichever side has more open space
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 39, overtaking must always be made on the left side of the vehicle being passed, returning to the right lane only when safely clear.

questions.question: In which of the following situations is overtaking strictly PROHIBITED under RA 4136?
questions.a: On multi-lane straight expressways
questions.b: Approaching the crest of a hill, on blind curves, at railway crossings, and within intersections
questions.c: On open dry highways during daytime
questions.d: When passing a stationary bicycle on the shoulder
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 41, passing is strictly prohibited on blind curves, hills with obstructed views, railway crossings, intersections, and school zones.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the extreme Leftmost lane on Philippine multi-lane expressways (e.g. SLEX, NLEX, SCTEX, TPLEX)?
questions.a: Cruising lane for slow-moving trucks and buses
questions.explanation: Expressway regulations dictate 'Keep Right Except to Pass'. The leftmost lane (Lane 1) is dedicated for overtaking; lingering in it constitutes lane hogging.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit for passenger cars on Philippine expressways (e.g. NLEX / SLEX)?
questions.a: 60 km/h
questions.explanation: The maximum legal speed limit for passenger cars on Philippine expressways is 100 km/h (minimum speed is 60 km/h).

questions.question: When driving at 80 km/h in ideal weather conditions, what is the minimum safe following distance recommended by the defensive driving rule?
questions.a: At least 1 car length
questions.b: The 3-Second Rule (increasing to 4–6 seconds in rainy or slippery conditions)
questions.d: Close enough to read their license plate
questions.explanation: The 3-Second Rule ensures adequate perception and braking distance under normal dry conditions, and should be doubled during heavy rain or wet roads.

questions.question: What is the official title of Republic Act No. 4136?
questions.a: The Clean Air Act of the Philippines
questions.b: The Land Transportation and Traffic Code
questions.c: The Anti-Drunk and Drugged Driving Act
questions.explanation: Republic Act No. 4136 is officially entitled 'The Land Transportation and Traffic Code' of the Philippines, enacted as the primary governing traffic statute.

questions.question: What is the legal status of a driver's license in the Philippines?
questions.a: A constitutional right granted to all adult citizens
questions.b: A privilege granted by the government through the LTO, subject to revocation or suspension for traffic violations
questions.d: A lifetime identification card that cannot be confiscated
questions.explanation: A driver's license in the Philippines is a privilege, not a right. The government, through the LTO, may suspend or revoke it for violations of road safety laws.

questions.question: Under RA 4136, during what hours must headlights on all moving motor vehicles be illuminated?
questions.a: From 8:00 PM to 4:00 AM
questions.b: From at least thirty minutes past sunset until at least thirty minutes before sunrise, or whenever visibility is poor
questions.c: Only during complete pitch black darkness
questions.d: Only when driving on provincial highways
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 34(c), headlights must be lighted from 30 minutes after sunset until 30 minutes before sunrise, and at any time when natural light is insufficient.

questions.question: When meeting an oncoming motor vehicle on a dark highway at night, within how many meters must you dip (switch to low beam) your headlights?
questions.a: At least 50 meters
questions.b: At least 200 meters (or as soon as oncoming headlights appear)
questions.d: Only when the oncoming driver flashes their high beams
questions.explanation: To prevent blinding oncoming drivers with high-beam glare, switch to low beams within at least 200 meters of an approaching oncoming vehicle.

questions.question: What is required of a holder of a Student Driver's Permit when operating a motor vehicle on any public highway?
questions.a: They may drive alone if carrying an LTO official receipt
questions.b: They must be accompanied by a duly licensed driver (holding a valid Non-Professional or Professional Driver's License)
questions.c: They may only drive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM
questions.d: They can only drive an automatic transmission vehicle
questions.explanation: Under RA 4136 Section 30, a student driver cannot operate a motor vehicle unless accompanied by a licensed driver who is seated beside the student.
